hypothesis: Conditional recording-mode innovations cluster within airline and observed UTC takeoff day; independent per-flight priors omit target-peer covariance. Not a claim of causal recorder state or taxi gain.

novelty.existing: Joint public moments sum independent-flight covariance. Monthly odds shifts change marginal means; source/runway covariance changes observation noise. This diagnostic concerns dependence at fixed row marginals.

grouping: Existing rome_signals.airline_code(FLIGHT_mvt), with IATA fallback, crossed with observed UTC takeoff date. No assigned date, intraday window, missing-ID cluster, airline selection or grouping scan.
justification: Airline flight-plan reporting channels and existing airline/handler signals motivate one carrier/day group at public temporal resolution. No actual handler/recording workflow identity is established.
probability_family: Six retained63-feature source-blind R20 inner classifiers,1700rounds/seed42, three whole-month partitions perouter. Five departure-label-history fields removed. Exact own/peer-month exclusion. These are not final Cat3/R20 or tilted-support marginals. Never open g3 outer-held files.

scope.membership: Exact saved g0-g2 IDs, unique, receipt-held-ID hash and declared months validated before labels; full cached probability export remains complete.
scope.input_filter: LIRF, finite3600<gap<50400, known airline, finite p in[0,1]. No y-based row selection.
scope.label: Original substituted outcome abs(gap-raw_taxi_sec)<=60 inclusive. Read only allowed training month label cache; assert all joined labels finite, no target cap.
scope.inputs: Reuse compact posterior-aware rows/features and separate month label parquets. Only airline spelling needs narrow label-free FLIGHT_mvt extraction from original allowed-month raw files; use original parser.
scope.outer_exclusion: Exclusion is per outer fold: Jan can be allowed training for July and July for Jan; never read that particular outer held month in its own computation.

control.fixed_eligibility: Retain strata represented on>=4 distinct observed UTC days; report all attrition.
control.permutation: 199 PCG64(seed20261013) permutations of whole(u,v) tuples within each stratum across fixed day slots; sort IDs first. Preserve stratum/day counts; no cross-stratum or cross-outer shuffling.
control.limitation: Controls stable/coarse marginal propensity, not omitted day-varying marginal bias. Positive dependence need not be caused by recorder state.

statistic.cross: For each airline/day, (sum u)^2-sum(u^2), ordered distinct pairs; singleton0.
statistic.contrast: sum(observed_cross-mean199_permuted_cross)/sum(v). Fixed input gap is a mode-separation proxy, not a fitted endpoint. Denominator invariant to tuple permutation. Report as excess mode-variance ratio, not correlation or taxi gain.
statistic.uncertainty: 2000 PCG64(seed20261014) whole-UTC-day bootstrap samples within each month; reuse fixed null day means and recompute numerator/denominator ratio. Both outer windows overlap and are not independent confirmation.

gate.pass: All conditions in both original training windows plus independent source/scope/statistic audit.
gate.fail: With adequate support, failed materiality/uncertainty gate closes this fixed pilot only; no causal null claim, grouping/threshold/stratum tuning, copula fit, taxi CV, production or upload.
gate.positive: Only permission to consider a separately frozen posterior experiment; no candidate automatically follows.
gate.insufficient_coverage: Inconclusive/insufficient support, no further allocation; do not interpret as absence of dependence.

outputs: Hashes/coverage/attrition, aggregate per-day numerator+denominator, permutation distribution, bootstrap interval and explicit decisions. No rowwise taxi candidate.

cost.runtime: 20–60sec anticipated, oneCPU, <1GiB. Root allocation after source/independent synthetic checks.

future_requirements: Preserve each selected final tilted support atom/mass, not raw classifierp.
Zero-dependence must replay original controls exactly.
Condition peer means and covariance on target state; variance inflation alone is insufficient.
Keep source-minus-truth calibrated measurement noise separate from prior-mode dependence.
Out-of-block public aggregate predictive calibration and actual-v80 CV/audit required before any selection.
headroom: Several-second improvement remains unproven. Existing v80 diagnosis shows material Rome-mode error; two unobserved LFPG outliers dominate other apparent oracle headroom.
